description: Rete di stazioni GNSS ISPRA - Dataset is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sgi3.isprambiente.it. Location of the permanent GNSS stations constituting the ISPRA network, aimed at monitoring surface deformations in areas characterized by phenomena of different nature. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Network of GNSS stations ISPRA - Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GPS, stazione di monitoraggio, GNSS, Open data, RINEX, geodesia. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
